scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build && pnpm run build:copy-frontend
scripts.build:copy-frontend: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join(process.cwd(), 'artifacts', 'dentsalud', 'dist', 'public'); const dest = path.join(process.cwd(), 'artifacts', 'api-server', 'dist', 'public'); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Frontend files copied to api-server/dist/public'); } else { console.log('Frontend build output not found'); }"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
